summary: Defines a BGP-based auto-discovery mechanism for Layer-1 VPNs, letting provider edge devices find other edges with ports in the same VPN. That information is needed to complete signaling. It aims for single-end provisioning where adding a port needs changes only at one PE and one CE. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Think of a club where each branch must know the others. This lets branches announce themselves, so adding one new door does not require rewriting every list.
